features.title: Background batched fetch (Step 7)
features.description: Extend use-dataset-studio-fetch to loop tag/time batches over dataSourceService.fetchData; progress %, current tag + batch, ETA, cancel via AbortController, retry failed batch; merge into dwRawDatasetAtom via piResponseToDataset.
features.scope_note: Backend already chunks tags+time-windows concurrently per /fetch (data_service.py:286), so P6's deliverable is CLIENT-VISIBLE GRANULARITY, not throughput. Batch dimension = TAGS only (chunk by fetchConfig.batchSize; batchSize still passed through so server's internal _chunk degenerates to one chunk — behavior preserved). Sequential (not Promise.all) so ETA is meaningful + cancel is clean; accepted-slower than the single server fan-out.
verificationResults: lib/dataset-fetch.ts (pure additions): chunkTags (clamps size<1 to 1 — never zero-length/infinite loop) + mergeDataset (returns a BRAND-NEW {tags,rows} so jotai's Object.is bail-out never swallows an incremental write; ordered tag union; rows merged by timestamp+sorted; backfills every missing cell as {value:0,status:'Bad'} so ragged batch timestamps keep piResponseToDataset's missing=Bad invariant through the cleaning path).
services/data-sources.ts: fetchData<T>(id, body, signal?) — additive AbortSignal forwarded to fetchClient (fetcher spreads options into fetch); 2-arg preview call site unchanged.

store/dataset-studio.ts: new dwFetchProgressAtom (FetchProgress: totalBatches/completedBatches/currentBatchTags/totalTags/completedTags/etaMs/failedBatches) kept SEPARATE from dwFetchStateAtom so the shared FetchState shape is untouched; seeded+reset in initDatasetWizardAtom + resetDatasetWizardAtom.

use-dataset-studio-fetch: sequential batched loop over dataSourceService.fetchData(signal). Merges each batch into dwRawDatasetAtom live (constant overlay re-applied to the MERGED set each write). Any non-abort batch failure keeps going, records the batch, ends at status:'error' (so the wizard auto-advance-on-'done' effect never fires with partial data). New api: start, retry(=full re-run), retryFailed(tags,period), cancel, detail:FetchProgress. Reuses piFetchInputError single-PI-source guard. No nested setState (local failedThisRun drives the terminal decision).

State-lifetime hardening (wizard-shell switch()es steps, so step-2 UNMOUNTS on nav and the useRef context is dropped while dwFetchProgressAtom persists): retryFailed takes (tags,period) and REBUILDS the request context via shared buildContext — the error branch's 'Retry N failed batches' still works after leaving+returning to step 2 (was a silent no-op). start's guard-fail branch now resets dwFetchProgressAtom + dwRawDatasetAtom so a fresh invalid attempt can't render a stale partial table / dead retry button. Cancel = discard: aborts to status:'idle' AND clears dwRawDatasetAtom (step-2 advance is gated on status==='done' at use-dataset-pipeline-nav:217, so a truncated dataset must not linger where a later goTo could carry it into preprocessing/save). runBatches seeds the progress bar from completedBatches (retryFailed no longer flashes to 0%).

Error branch now renders Alert + partial RawReadingsTable + 'Retry N failed batches' (retryFailed) + 'Re-fetch all' — error no longer swallows the partial data. Auto-advance effect unchanged (only fires on 'done', which partial-failure never reaches).

features.title: CSV fetch bypass (Step 2 becomes source validation)
features.description: An all-CSV dataset run skips the Fetch Data requirement entirely: the uploaded file is materialized into the raw dataset and the fetch state settles to done, so Continue unlocks without any API call.
features.scope_note: User-approved deviation from the request: the spec asked only for UI gating (fetchRequired -> canContinue), but the real Step-2 gate is canAdvance case 2 = 'status done AND rows > 0'. Flipping the status alone would unlock Continue and then break Step 3 (precleanse rows > 0), the charts, and Save — nothing in the codebase ever converted CSV content into a Dataset. So the fix materializes the CSV instead, and canAdvance is left untouched. User decisions: (1) Step-1 upload is the authoritative CSV entry point (Step-1 tags for a csv source otherwise come from defaultMockTags and are fake); (2) timestamp column auto-detected and normalized to ISO, synthetic fallback otherwise; (3) scope is CSV-only — spec Case 5 (mixed CSV+PI) is NOT built, because piFetchInputError rejects any multi-source selection today and merging non-aligned timestamps would yield a mostly-Bad grid.
verificationResults: lib/csv.ts (pure): parseCsvText / detectTimestampColumn / csvToDataset. Timestamps normalized to ISO so the lexicographic sort used everywhere is chronological; no time column (or an unparseable cell) falls back to a deterministic MATERIALIZE_EPOCH + 1min series. Bad-cell invariant mirrors piResponseToDataset — blank/non-numeric become {value:0,status:'Bad'}, never NaN, never dropped. Replaces the two ad-hoc parsers in csv-config-form.tsx and use-dataset-tag-table.ts.

store/dataset-studio.ts: dwCsvDatasetAtom + dwCsvFileNameAtom (reset in all three lifecycle writers) and derived dwFetchRequiredAtom = selectedSources.some(type !== 'csv'). Empty selection reads false, which is safe: an empty dataset still fails the rows>0 half of the gate.

hooks/dataset/use-dataset-tag-table.ts: uploadCompare now parses the whole file (was header-only) into dwCsvDatasetAtom; tag rows come from Dataset.tags, so the detected timestamp column never becomes a tag.

hooks/dataset/use-csv-materialize.ts (new): narrows the CSV grid to the selected tags (missing tags backfilled Bad), applies applyConstantOverlay, writes dwRawDatasetAtom and sets fetch state done — mirroring the edit-mode seam. Guarded on !fetchRequired && status !== 'done', so it is idempotent and re-arms after nav.resetFetch().

step-2-raw-data.tsx: Fetch Period/Fetch Data block, the 'Couldn't fetch sensor data' branch, and the per-source config cards all gated on fetchRequired; CSV runs get a 'CSV Dataset Ready' card (file name, column/row counts, no-fetch-needed notice) and reuse the existing Dataset Ready summary + raw table. advanceOnDone left alone — it only fires after an explicit Fetch click, so the CSV path cannot auto-advance.

Re-upload safety: uploadCompare calls nav.resetFetch() after swapping the parsed grid. Without it the fetch state stayed 'done' and Step 2 kept rendering the FIRST file's rows while the card showed the second file's name/counts. Tags still accumulate across uploads (unchanged compare semantics); carried-over tags the new file lacks materialize as Bad columns until deselected.

Edit-mode guard: the CSV branches are gated on `!nav.isEditLocked` (csvBypass) and the step label on `fetchRequired || isEditLocked`. A saved dataset whose sources are all CSV (or resolve empty) would otherwise hide the locked fetch surface and show 'Source Validation' + a 'No CSV data yet' card, contradicting the EditLockBanner.

Known limitation (pre-existing, now user-visible): saved CSV datasets do not round-trip. initDatasetWizardForEditAtom rebuilds the grid with buildRawDataset (synthetic readings) because the uploaded file is never persisted — editing a CSV dataset therefore operates on generated values, and saving persists a recipe derived from them. Out of scope here; would need artifact storage for the raw file.
